operationDefinitions.semantics: remove one schema-required property from a schema-valid preimage
replace one bound identity with a different canonical identity of the same type
append one member lacking an admitted universe identity
present a valid-shaped transition against a non-current expected-old head or expired cut
reorder or skip one mandatory transaction step
present one Permit class to a different Permit consumer
add a current-looking receipt whose subject or authority conflicts with the accepted cut

oracleDefinitions.terminalDerivation: execute target schema and cross-field evaluator; return evaluator terminal
execute lifecycle/CAS/Permit evaluator; return evaluator terminal

executionBoundary: Readers validate vector/schema/terminal linkage only. No vector executes until its independently accepted evaluator implementation root exists.
